value_class_vector: class C { int $n = 1; } $c value<C> = new C(); $v vector<value<C>> = [$c]; $v[0] = $c; $d = $v[0]; return $d->n;
value_class_nullable: class C { int $n = 1; } $c value<C> = new C(); $n nullable<value<C>> = $c; $d value<C> = $n; return $d->n;
value_class_hash: class C { int $n = 1; } $c value<C> = new C(); $h hash<value<C>> = {x: $c}; $h['x'] = $c; $d = $h['x']; return $d->n;
container_implicit_upcast: class B {} class D extends B {} $v vector<B> = [new D()]; $v[] = new D(); return 0;
container_implicit_bad_downcast: class B {} class D extends B {} $v vector<D> = [new B()]; return 0;
vector_result_function: $f function<int()> = fn(): int => 1; $v vector<result<function<int()>>> = [$f]; $r = $v[0]; $g function<int()> = $r; return $g();
vector_nullable_record: struct S { int $n = 1; } $v vector<nullable<S>> = [new S(), null]; $v[1] = new S(); $s S = $v[0]; return $s->n;
nullable_record_ternary: struct S { int $n = 1; } $s ?S = new S(); $t = true ? $s : $s; return isset($t) ? 1 : 0;
